name: nasa-power-mcp-server
description: Query NASA POWER solar, wind, building, and agroclimatology data via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE.title: Analytical workspace
CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE.description: duckdb (default) stages larger datasets for SQL on supported platforms; none keeps results inline.

CANVAS_DEFAULT_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB.title: Engine memory per canvas
CANVAS_DEFAULT_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB.description: Per-canvas engine memory in MiB, integer >=64; not total RSS or temporary disk.

CANVAS_MAX_CANVASES_PER_TENANT.title: Tenant canvas cap
CANVAS_MAX_CANVASES_PER_TENANT.description: Positive active canvas limit per tenant; auth-none callers share one tenant.

CANVAS_TTL_MS.title: Sliding canvas lifetime
CANVAS_TTL_MS.description: Positive sliding canvas lifetime in milliseconds.

CANVAS_ABSOLUTE_CAP_MS.title: Absolute canvas lifetime
CANVAS_ABSOLUTE_CAP_MS.description: Absolute canvas lifetime in milliseconds, at least the sliding TTL.

NASA_POWER_MAX_CANVASES_PER_PROCESS.title: Process canvas cap
NASA_POWER_MAX_CANVASES_PER_PROCESS.description: Positive active or pending canvas limit for this process.

NASA_POWER_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.title: Enable dataframe removal
NASA_POWER_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.description: Expose explicit staged-table removal (true or false). Requires the duckdb provider for table operations.
